verdict.rationale: The core Pulumi engine/CLI is open-source and can run fully self-hosted via a DIY state backend (S3/GCS/Azure Blob or local file), confirmed hands-on by probes showing preview/up/destroy succeeding with zero Pulumi Cloud dependency (pulumi-probe-6, pulumi-probe-7), and pricing page explicitly lists 'self-hosting available' (pulumi-docs-27). However, community feedback notes that in practice Pulumi has historically felt tied to a hosted 'mothership' and lacks good on-prem/bare-metal support (pulumi-comm-9, pulumi-comm-14), and premium features like Neo, Insights/Policy, and MCP integration are Pulumi Cloud-only, so full self-hosting of the entire product suite is not clearly delivered.
